lyrics_set.lyrics:
[Intro]
[Verse]
Where the golden mountains touch the sky
Where the ancient rivers wander by
Every stone holds a story told
In the shadows, memories unfold
[Pre-Chorus]
The wind whispers secrets of old
Watch the map of the future unfold
[Chorus]
Rise like the sun on the plain
Break through the clouds and the rain
A legacy written in light
To soar through the reaches of height
[Verse]
A thousand footsteps on a dusty road
Where the heavy heart finds its load
From the valley deep and wide
To the peaks where the eagles glide
[Pre-Chorus]
The stars align in the night
Turning the darkness to light
[Chorus]
Rise like the sun on the plain
Break through the clouds and the rain
A legacy written in light
To soar through the reaches of height
[Instrumental]
[Bridge]
A single spark becomes a flame
Calling the spirit to speak its name
[Chorus]
Rise like the sun on the plain
Break through the clouds and the rain
A legacy written in light
To soar through the reaches of height
[Outro]
